description: Agent-neutral Orlix TCTI next-task roadmap. Repo-local workflow data for the orlix-tcti-next-step skill, not an MCP server.

forbidden_scope: Do not enable CONFIG_ORLIX_HOSTED_EXEC_TCTI in product defconfigs before flip gates pass.
Do not edit generated Linux trees under Build/OrlixKernel/src/linux-*-port.
Do not run simulator or physical-device gates.
reducer_requirements: If this gate fails, emit a reducer or concrete stale-reference command before editing runtime code.
gates.commit_message_template: chore(tcti): keep plan and config rails consistent
stop_conditions: Stop if product defconfigs default to TCTI.
Stop if ADR or PLAN stale references contradict the current TCTI ownership model.

forbidden_scope: Do not mark TODO or evidence reports as pass.
Do not make a schema checker that passes without checking pass and fail fixtures.
reducer_requirements: Schema failures must name the failing report or fixture path.
gates.commit_message_template: test(tcti): harden report schema rail
stop_conditions: Stop if status and passed semantics are ambiguous.

forbidden_scope: Do not assume Apple clang can produce the required Linux ELF without recording the probe.
Do not check generated binaries into the source tree unless a separate review approves it.
reducer_requirements: Toolchain failures must record clang, ld.lld, file, readelf or objdump facts.
gates.commit_message_template: test(tcti): record golden elf toolchain proof
stop_conditions: Stop if the local toolchain cannot produce an AArch64 Linux ELF and no TODO report is emitted.

forbidden_scope: Do not hide current HostAdapter native findings with ignorelists or weakened scanner patterns.
Do not claim product safety while native hosted execution remains product-selected.
Do not move Linux syscall, TLS, VFS, fd-table, process, signal, or scheduler semantics into HostAdapter.
Do not allow host x18 or w18 in TCTI product assembly or generated gadgets.
Do not allow MAP_JIT, RWX, generated executable memory, or host-executable guest text.
Do not expose guest software to native iOS APIs.
Do not flip product defconfigs to CONFIG_ORLIX_HOSTED_EXEC_TCTI=y before the product-default gates pass.
Do not edit generated Linux build trees.
reducer_requirements: Safety failures must identify the exact source, generated, or object-disassembly path.
Every failing forbidden_behavior family must produce at least one replayable reducer under Build/TCTI/reproducers/tcti-appstore-safety-audit/.
The appstore-safety report artifacts array must include every generated reducer path.
Each safety reducer must replay through make tcti-gate TARGET=tcti-repro REPRO=<path> and record target, case_id, command, expected_status, reason, and artifacts.
Each safety failure must include structured scanner metadata: scanner id, forbidden_behavior field, source kind, path, line or disassembly line, and matched pattern id.
The report must include a scan manifest covering production roots, scanned source count, object-disassembly paths, object count, and coverage warnings.
A passing appstore-safety report must be generated at current HEAD and must not rely on stale git_sha evidence.
HostAdapter native-exec remediation failures must keep a replayable tcti-appstore-safety-audit report with forbidden_behavior fields.
If compiled product artifacts still contain forbidden native hosted-exec symbols, the report must name the object or source path.
gates.commit_message_template: test(tcti): gate native hostadapter exec from safety path
stop_conditions: Stop on any forbidden executable-memory or x18 finding.
Stop on any HostAdapter Linux trap semantics or native iOS exposure finding.
Stop if the remediation requires product defconfigs to default to TCTI.
Stop if the remediation would delete unrelated HostAdapter boot, memory mapping, terminal, or observability plumbing.
Stop if the selected change cannot preserve native hosted execution behind an explicit non-product debug or test boundary.
